We have reviewed your matter with care. You reported that, during your recent travel with Nala, you encountered distress and uncertainty around the handling of her travel arrangements and the level of support provided, and you felt the communication did not reflect the seriousness of your concerns. 

At Aurelia Skyways, we expect every passenger and companion animal to be treated with prompt, respectful attention from the first preparations through the boarding process. Our welcome team prepares travelers for smooth departure, and our supervisors listen carefully when a passenger is worried. When a situation involves a pet in transit, our priority is clear guidance, steady follow-through, and a calm, supportive tone that helps the passenger feel informed rather than left to guess.

We also recognize that what feels like a small gap in communication can feel large when you are traveling with a companion animal. To address what you described, the Companion Animal Travel Desk has asked the relevant team to review the communication steps used for your itinerary and to confirm that staff followed our standard expectations for updates, boarding coordination, and document checks. We are also ensuring that the team reinforces guidance for passengers who are emotionally invested in the safe handling of their animal.

<<FACT F120>>

If you have any additional details you are able to share, such as the exact moment you felt support was missing or any reference information tied to your booking, that will help our records team align the review more precisely. Andre Svensson and Ravi Rossi are welcome to have this information consolidated through the same channel for consistency and accuracy.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and we will use your feedback to strengthen future support for travelers and their companions.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
